description: ArcGIS Parcel Harvester is a Python command-line tool for assembling public farmland and parcel research layers. It enumerates state GIS and federal ArcGIS services, classifies layers by name into twelve categories and writes selected features as GeoPackages in EPSG:4326. Categories include parcels, administrative boundaries, soils, cropland, flood zones and hydrography. The README documents state configuration, dry-run planning, object-ID batching, resumable progress and category merging. Coverage is intended for the United States; available layers, spatial resolution and observation dates depend on each source service. The code is freely published under MIT, while downloaded-source terms remain separate. A limitation is that the provider reports blocked automated access to NRCS services and no statewide South Dakota parcel polygon layer; county ownership and assessment fields are not supplied by the state portals. Name-based classification can also miss relevant layers. Simulation uses include preparing land-use and hazard overlays for agricultural, siting and flood-exposure scenarios. It complements data-usda-acpf-database but does not replace source-specific field definitions or verify topology merely by sharing a CRS. No harvesting, dry run or installation was executed.
